methods.drop10: Drop each own past anchor with probability0.1 for the whole video window.
methods.drop25: Drop each own past anchor with probability0.25 for the whole video window.
methods.drop50: Drop each own past anchor with probability0.5 for the whole video window.
methods.context-mask: Mask changes between the own past anchor and first observed frame, with5x5dilation. No future target forms the mask.

protocol.basis: Prior short screens gave no robust planning winner. Test whether past-anchor side information permits omission of control-relevant scene information; retain all original grounding gradients.
protocol.scope: Existing mature models, short adaptation only. All candidates remain sample-level, no cross-sample statistics, EMA or additional parameters. All targets and prior inputs remain attached; preserve RGB grounding gradients. Original flow/rate, sample-local past-anchor augmentation only. Inference still uses the normal past anchor.
protocol.gate: Stop all20training at600extra updates; review finite weights, posterior/interventions, paired P0 before any continuation. Do not infer that side-information shortcuts are established before paired task/probe evidence. Rendering without an anchor is harder; raw loss units and learning balance must be reported.

limitations: 600update adaptation from an existing2epochcheckpoint; not from-scratch training or a stability result.
Four existing mature training seeds; final claims need independent from-scratch training and unused evaluation cases.
P0twoevalseeds,16CFcases and64generationclips are a screen, not the full original benchmark.
Bootstrap intervals condition on these fixed weights and episode clusters; not uncertainty across training seeds.
Candidate/control comparisons are exploratory with no multiple-testing correction; selected wins require independent confirmation.
Forward values match the original rate/FM; semipast-anchor augmentation is not full-gradient original KL optimization.
Same parameter/update count is not equal compute; report per-arm training time and extra model calls.
Future states only enter training targets within the same video; no futureRGB is passed to inference.
